description: Land Title Settlement Department - Horethuduwa, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530011
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in various villages, making it primarily concerned with land and property-related matters. The content falls under the Land Gazette classification as it involves the official registration and determination of land titles, which is the core focus of Type 4 gazettes.
